content: Since $\mathsf {H}^{\textsc {T}}_\alpha $ is strictly convex on the simplex, $\mathop {\mathsf {\alpha }\textnormal {-}\mathsf {entmax }}$ has a unique solution $\mathbf {p}^\star $. Equation DISPLAY_FORM88 implicitly defines a one-to-one mapping between $\mathbf {p}^\star $ and $\tau ^\star $ as long as $\mathbf {p}^\star \in \triangle $, therefore $\tau ^\star $ is also unique.
